notes.title: Fleapit’s Grab Bag: Back to the Grab Bag
notes.content:
Heeeeeey Guests of the Fleapit~

Coming right at ya is yet another Fleapit devlog where we drag you kicking and screaming through the depths of development hell (or rather Inferno) and show all the exciting stuff (that we can show at this point in time)!

As per usual, the biggest bulk of the work we’ve been doing these last couple of months has been focused on behind-the-scenes stuff – but we’re making steady progress, pinky promise!!

That said, let’s dive into the nitty gritty, shall we?

[h3]UPKEEPING THE OLD STUFF[/h3]

Turns out working on a game breeds… even more game. Thankfully, at this point we’re more that ever aware that polishing things into perfection isn’t exactly the way to go, but making additional touches here and there won’t hurt anybody.

Like, for example, here’s a new cute little sprite for Ruby’s speech during the opening cutscene:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PGPkTjq9/image5.gif[/img]
[i]of course its Ruby breaking the 4th wall, who else?[/i]

Would you love to see more of these? Definitely let us know in the comments, y’all!

[h3]GLITCHES NO GLITCHING[/h3]

One of the more requested things from the previous demo was to remove the visual glitches during dungeon crawling. So we did exactly that…and also added an option to have even more visual glitches, should you choose to do so. 

For reference, we believe that the Full glitches option represents our vision for Fleapit’s chaotic visuals, but we don’t wanna ruin anyone’s personal experience, so feel free to turn them down!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hJpVR0jj/image3.gif[/img]
[i]warning: the slider doesn’t actually influence any of the gameplay glitches. . .[/i]

[h3]HOT DEMON LADY WITH NO CONTEXT[/h3]

It’s that time of the year again! The Freaked Fleapit roster of characters is growing with its development and it’s always fun to just show you the concept arts with no context whatsoever.

Even though you don’t know her just yet, we know you’re gonna grow to love her… eventually~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/35e8e6ff39f2f0391cc79f71ae096d0e8b629f31.png[/img]
[i]we were this close to just stop on the bald version[/i]

[h3]WOULD YOU LIKE A FASARIA TAMAGOTCHI?[/h3]

Now, I’m not saying we’re working on one! I’m not even saying that we will ever be working on one. But [i]hypothetically[/i] is this something of interest for you?

And could I perhaps influence your answer by showing you this lil creature?
[img]https://i.ibb.co/k2vKtZvf/image2.gif[/img]

[h3]FREAKED FLEAPIT TRIVIA BIT: GOD I WISH THIS WAS ME[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e294c0d612b9ba6475771b3472d4714b0b9d5235.png[/img]
[i]ok, seriously though, that’s just a new concept art that was made in time while i was writing this very devlog. Consider it a freebie for waiting extra long lol.[/i]

Oh-kay, that’s gonna be it for today’s special!

It’s our cue to crawl back into the (development) Inferno, keep hammering away, and emerge again soon with more cursed updates. As always, thank you for coming along for the ride and see you next time.

Love y’all~
Finch Bird Studio

[url=https://twitter.com/FreakedFleapit][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/51a12620723d81c187569c79c4e646824ed1a5dc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Fleapit’s Grab Bag Returns... With Vengeance!
notes.content:
[h3]Heeeeeey Guests of the Fleapit~[/h3]

We may have skipped a month or two of these devlogs, hope that was just about enough time for you to start missing us a little bit! 

Truth be told, we had to go slower than usual this last month due to quite a few team members getting sick (including me, who writes this very text lol), but we’re very much back in action and today we’re gonna make it up to you with quite a few gameplay bits from the upcoming New And Improved Steam Demo that we’ve been talking a lot in the past.

So let’s get the show rolling, shall we?

[h3]New Traps, New Foes[/h3]

For starters, we can finally show more enemies that will torture your existence in the upcoming updated demo!

As you might recall, we promised to extend each Circle of Hell with subfloors – with each one containing a few exclusive demons that get progressively harder the deeper you go! This time around we’re going to focus on Limbo exclusively, so stay tuned for the next episode to see more, ok?~

[b]MIMIC[/b]

Ah, the FromSoft classic! Some of the props around Limbo contain pesky Mimics which will emerge as soon as you approach them, so keep an eye out for this pair of eyes and maybe tone down the aggression towards the surrounding furniture, just in case.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oQ2OZ5u.gif[/img]

[b]COFFEE MANIAC[/b]

Surely this much coffee can’t be good for you? Well, Coffee Maniac seems to disagree – as long as a coffee machine is nearby, he’s literally unkillable. Without his fuel, however, he’s quite vulnerable, so you better dart across the room and de-coffee-fy it before finishing the poor sod off!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lKbXDMa.gif[/img]

[b]BOOKKEEPER[/b]

Watch your steps cuz it’s raining books! These nerdy demons prefer to take cover in the most annoying parts of any given room and support the main cast of enemies with projectiles that will keep you on the move. Imagine being sandwiched in a room between a bookkeeper and a coffee maniac and you’re in for a fun time~

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hdiyfjm.gif[/img]

Of course, there’s even more demons we didn’t mention so far – but you’ll have to see them for yourselves. It wouldn’t be fun to spoil everything after all, right?

[h3]More Items = More Fun[/h3]

One of the things that was highly requested after the first demo were more impactful items. Ask and you shall receive, dear Guests of the Fleapit!

First of all, the random pick ups are categorized as ‘items’ and ‘skills’: the former ones being one-time use and latter recharging after a certain number of rooms is successfully cleared.

Let’s go over a couple of examples together, shall we?

[b]GARLIC BREATH[/b]

A one-time use item that is all about dealing AoE damage in a massive radius. Just find a few suitable targets and deploy the stench that makes even the toughest demons suffer! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CNRxG35.gif[/img]

[b]PURE SIN[/b]

This one’s trickier to use, but the potential for carnage is endless! Once you use a bottle of Pure Sin, you will have poisonous puddles appear underneath Newbie for a few beats and if you can predict where the enemies will be or if a lot of them are chasing you, this is a perfect recipe for quickly thinning the enemy ranks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1GDfLbr.gif[/img]


[h3]Special Quests[/h3]

You didn’t think your visits to Circles of Hell are some kind of one and done thing, did you? Throughout your journey, Ladies of Fleapit will have requests for you – sometimes in the lobby, other times right in the dungeon.

Complete them and get the ultimate reward – the affection of a demon girl!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MrJxu8O.gif[/img]


[h3]WARNING: A new never-before-shown art from Mr. Psina is approaching fast:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/5fa15c9d54fb284e22c6b3b28703a2e61a95bba9.png[/img]

[i]I don’t have anything else to add, really, lol![/i]

[i][h3]Quick Fleapit Trivia Bit: Diffusion Crystals[/h3]

One of the most important and incredibly scarce resources of Inferno as it allows the Freaked Fleapit to be in a stable state and not descend into complete chaos. Also used by the Lords of Hell to stabilize their offices. The production of the crystals is kept a closely guarded secret so that they will always be valuable.[/i]

And that’s where we’ll hit the brakes and stop today’s devlog! We still have much to show, but we don’t want to give away everything just yet, so make sure to come by next month to see what else we got for ya!

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: Fleapit's January Grab Bag
notes.content:
[h3]Heeeeeey Guests of the Fleapit~[/h3]
Guess who’s back with a brand new devlog! 

As always, January’s kind of a slow month for us, so we won’t have that many updates for y’all today, but at least we’re here and we brought some cute arts! So without further ado, let’s begin the first Fleapit HQ Direct of 2025.

[b]Ready? Let’s gooooooo![/b]

[h3]All Rise, The Court is Now in Session[/h3]

In Freaked Fleapit you’ll have many opportunities and places to date cute demon girls. But since Ruby’s, errr, a special case, we’re making sure that every encounter with her is as unforgettable and bonkers as the pink-underboobed-poltergeist  herself.

So, here’s your very special date right in the courtroom. Featuring Ruby as Judge, Jury and Executioner all at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/dbb143961e79e17219bf939bee779876a6565605.png[/img]

But don’t fret, guests of the Fleapit, cuz you’ll be represented in the Inferno’s Court of Almighty Law by the one and only Attorney Extraordinare – [b]Ryubichi Na-Ruby-hodo [/b][spoiler](name strictly placeholder, Capcom don’t sue us pls)[/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/c3fdc4c656cc8faa3f4552a593598645e31617f7.jpg[/img]

Will you go to jail or will you go to horny jail? Find out sometime in the future when Freaked Fleapit drops!

Ok, that’s enough of this bit, moving on to the

[h3]Compendium[/h3]

In one of our previous devlogs we mentioned Thales, a literal encyclopedia about the whole of Inferno found in the depths of Limbo.

Well, we can now also reveal that he’s gonna be your one and only database of all things Fleapit! All the relevant info about perks, items and enemies will be meticulously stored within this extremely arrogant (and extremely horny) book, so better get used to this insufferable nerd while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/50162d185dec1818f043d97a9bb3ff5c2283d49a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Little Babies, Please Take A Look[/h3]
Enough said, honestly. Please let us know if you want to see more of them and maybe we’ll make them into a cosmetic of sorts lmao

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/50b1730a8fd8d998c3cbe74112ac60062f5ff865.png[/img]

[h3]Freaked Fleapit OST Teaser via Magnetude[/h3]

Our previous soundtrack teaser from the Circle of Gluttony was met with such overwhelming love that we had to ask our composers at Magnetude if we could share more.

And BOY did they deliver! So please enjoy one more minute of Gluttony’s Beats to Get Eaten To, Guests of the Fleapit!!

[previewyoutube=VeMzjnOI8l4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]More Perks PogChamp More Perks PogChamp[/h3]

Looks like Andy found out about Inferno’s best financial tool called BNPN aka Buy Now Pay Never. At least until the Inferno Police don't pay enough attention to it…

What that means for the player is there’s a chance that your current item will not be consumed after using, so don’t go hoarding all those boosters until the end of the round, ok?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/d65905e38ad37444c6f7caeabad05ab839169a5c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Quick Fleapit Trivia Bit: Succubi[/h3]

The Succubi that have earned their freedom and have become more zealous in their duties. They seduce and then trap sinners using their many tentacles. 

But as time went on, the succubus realized how defenseless and shy she was outside the container, so she decided to keep her distance from the lustful sinners. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/c75e8b8651f2ba1b35c32d0aa2b55e833f52383f.png[/img]

And that brings us to the end of our devlog! Thank you for stopping by, and see you next time for yet another Fleapit's Freaky Grab Bag (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: http://patreon.com/FinchBird) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team & CRITICAL REFLEX signing off!

notes.title: Freaked Fleapit Dev HQ Direct — August ‘24
notes.content:
[h3]Hiya, guests of the Fleapit!~[/h3]

And welcome back to yet another edition of Fleapit HQ Direct where we show some of the cool stuff we’ve been working on behind the scenes! Strap in and come along for the ride, cuz there’s quite a bit to go through this time.

Y’all ready? Then let’s begin!

[h2]EXPANDING THE INFERNO[/h2]

One of the most often requested feedback we received from our demo was ‘please make longer levels’. And while we’ve already committed to make every Circle of Hell longer with three increasingly difficult levels, we want to make each one of them feel somewhat unique.

Thus, we’re working on creating special tiles for each zone that would feel more thematically appropriate and help us convey the storyline of each Circle of Hell!

Like, check out one of the deeper rooms of Limbo below (with a brand new enemy teaser haha)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/4b40e2f80de1856cd1c25feb28c12dfff8247804.gif[/img]

And to clarify: it’s not just about the floor, but most of the props, including the posters on the walls (hope you’ve been paying attention to these btw)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/c5f39ef85e96fb1b04ffd3f88b43d06c385e4d76.png[/img]
[i]some of these look oddly familiar . . [/i]

[h2]HERE COMES A NEW CHALLENGER![/h2]

Last time we introduced our brand new Shopkeeper and today we want to continue the tradition and share the sprite work for yet another character currently in works at the Fleapit HQ.

You’ll get to know him closer once the time comes, but for now please enjoy this first look at our Very Imposing Minotaur-man 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/f26f864588be29540551ecdf35ca6d1ab9e74258.png[/img]

[h2]NEW EMOTIONS UNLOCKED![/h2]

As the Fleapit script evolves, it requires more specific emotions from our characters than just default ‘sad/happy’ faces, so not unlike Inside Out 2 we’re unlocking new sprites for emotions when the scenes demand so,

And there’s one emotion in particular we’d like to share today! 

[b]WITNESS: RUBY. WITH. PUFFY. CHEEKS.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/0234215fb0fa6adc235ecc9e06d634e91bd7efa4.png[/img]
[i]Was this one heavily inspired by Fern from Frieren? Who knows, you won’t prove anything . . .[/i]

Anyway, moving onto the next topic!
[h2]NEWWWWW PEEEEERKS[/h2]

And of course we won’t leave y’all without any perk concepts that we’ve been working on! Introducing two new perks, code named Dango and Gold Rush respectively:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/409e80eff0759859f6ee40f01f1f1a4031b51980.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/2a5258db9f2c3073c3025dcc6a511b6025c52f83.jpg[/img]


[h2]FLEAPIT’S QUICK TRIVIA BIT: INFERNO’S GASTRO CULTURE[/h2]

Since Inferno is essentially a scorched wasteland (except for Hell City, that is), all food is synthetic and created from processed sin. Therefore, real meat, alcohol, etc. are highly valued in Inferno.

So better be grateful for having Bellboy at the Fleapit, ya jerk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/557def85dc00254c83992efead75533afdd5ab6e.png[/img]

And that brings us to the end of our devlog! Thank you for stopping by, and see you in the next Fleapit Direct (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: http://patreon.com/FinchBird) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: Freaked Fleapit Dev HQ Direct — June ‘24
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, guests of the Fleapit![/h3]

What a month, huh? We’re incredibly excited to share a sneak peek behind the gates of Fleapit, and seeing your genuine excitement and passion for our game filled us with even more determination to make the best rhythm--slash-dungeon crawler-slash-date sim ever!

That being said, there’s no time to waste basking in the afterglow for us. There’s still much to do based on both our original development plans and your demo feedback, so let’s get right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e2e6e75aa0a432d00602cec670afd9f5966135ea.gif[/img]

[h3]WHAT’S NEXT FOR THE DEMO[/h3]

Honestly, not much. We’ve worked up some quick bug fixes and we just added the Russian VO, but we’re now focusing on the Next Big Thing and, truthfully, we just don’t have the resources to also keep polishing this little demo further and further. 

We want to take a moment to restate how invaluable , and precious your feedback has been, and how incredibly thankful we are. We’re also extra excited to share that all that feedback will be implemented in…

[h3]ANOTHER NEW FLEAPIT DEMO..?![/h3]

Yep, you heard it right! I

And here’s what we’ve got in store for this next demo so far:

[list]
[*] [b]Meta-progression[/b] — more fleshed out roguelite elements, traders, perks, skills, meta-currency, and all that jazz 
[*] [b]5 dates[/b] with branching dialogue set in different locations 
[*] [b]The complete first 2 circles of Hell[/b] but this time bolder, bigger and more fun! 
[*] [b]Various mini-games[/b] including mixology, bowling, and more
[/list]

[h3][b]But that’s not all! [/b][/h3]

Thanks to all the amazing feedback we got from this first demo, we’ll be able to add some of your suggestions in as well to hopefully make this a somewhat complete experience that we’ll proceed with moving forward!

[i](pssst, this is also the part where we remind you that if you have any feedback you’d like to share with us, you can do it via [url=https://forms.gle/4QPubQy6hzjQiZcHA]this handy google form[/url] and we’ll take it into consideration, thanks in advance! <3)[/i]

We can’t promise a hard date for this next big demo thingy yet, but we are working like Hell and are hopeful it won’t take nearly as long as this last one!

And now, since we mentioned more fleshed out roguelite elements, allow us to introduce…

[h3]THE SHOPKEEPER[/h3]

It wouldn’t really be a roguelite if you can’t buy any items from a suspicious-looking merchant deep in a dungeon somewhere, would it? And since this is one of the latest characters we designed for Fleapit, we decided to share how he came to life from earlier concepts to the complete sprites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/6cf6240aa05df80005a867f77b049e2d0a50267c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/fe8c8e37926151f326437a146c2b437575b5c7ff.png[/img]
[i]The many, many iterations of the future Shopkeeper we had a first[/i]

It all begins with an idea. We decided that our Shopkeeper should be a powerful, intimidating, and mostly stationary figure early on, but it took a lot of fine tuning with details to settle on like ‘should this even be a living creature’ or ‘what the insides of his coat should look like’. 

And after a lot of consideration and heated debates (which included pointing at the Fleapit lore document quite a bit) we landed on this guy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/0c7fc25dbb421950180d183585789a168c6815b8.gif[/img]
[i]What are ya buyin’?[/i]

Okay, so now we have a dialogue sprite for the Shopkeeper, but the work doesn’t end here. In fact, now we’re getting to the interesting part — how do we make this fellow look good in pixel art? 

A lot of you were curious about our pixel art process, so we’ll let you on a little secret: the concept art for chibi-pixel versions of characters is also being done by our lead artist Mr. Psina. And here’s what the Shopkeeper looked like - chibified:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/60199ef20f97dc4ffb19ebe8d7a83329239411ee.png[/img]

Once we settled on this design, our beloved pixel artist Todo takes over, works his own personal magic, it all comes together! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/353850985ac5e9c3538d5bd3516b4ece7faf91cf.gif[/img]
[i]Bear witness for the Shopkeeper has come to life at last![/i]


We can’t wait for you to meet him in person! Trust us, he’s a lovely individual, even if he’s stingy as all hell. Anyways, moving on!

[h3]PERK ARTS POGCHAMP PERK ARTS[/h3]

In today’s edition of ‘Perks teasers’ we have a couple of those that we internally affectionately call [i]‘Andy gets absolutely decimated’[/i] and both of these, as you’ve probably guessed, have something to do with Newbie losing HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/acfdb0dbf831d6a36c49f5ec0e817e2753e05451.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e8db143cbf10a446b1a3db66fb91f0ee4f3b5078.jpg[/img]

While we don’t intend a ‘get hurt a lot’ playstyle to be viable, these might be helpful for those players who are new to the rhythm dungeon crawling and have occasional troubles with getting down the specific patterns and stuff. And you’ll see these, you guessed it, in the Next Steam Demo.

[h3]FLEAPIT’S QUICK TRIVIA BIT: REAPERS[/h3]

[i]Reapers reap (duh) and transport the shells of souls between the four worlds:
World of the Living -> Inferno -> Heaven -> Ministry of Death. 

All Reapers were once people who indirectly worked with death: undertakers, pathologists, death priests, etc. Wonder what made Fasaria become one.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/f1a9b26fe6bf528327fd34f78b99a1f662c729a4.png[/img]

And that brings us to the end of our devlog! Thank you for stopping by, and see you in the next Fleapit Direct (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: http://patreon.com/FinchBird) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the Former Bird Site and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: Freaked Fleapit Steam Demo is OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guests of Fleapit![/h2]

The moment that we've been talking about for so long is finally here: Freaked Fleapit demo is OUT NOW on Steam! We're incredibly pumped and excited to finally show a snippet of what we've been cooking publicly and we can't wait for your reactions to it!!

[previewyoutube=Darp8GH6udk;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, we'd very much like you to go and play it [b]Right Now[/b], but before that we have a few things we want to mention!

First of all, as previously mentioned [b]we still plan to release a bigger demo later down the road[/b]... yes, you guessed it, later™️. But we promise it's gonna be worth the wait as it's gonna include:
[list][*] [b]Meta-progression[/b] — more fleshed out roguelite elements, traders, perks, skills, meta-currency and all that jazz
[*] [b]5 dates[/b] with branching dialogue set in different locations 
[*] [b]The complete first 2 circles of Hell [/b]but this time bolder, bigger and more fun!
[*] [b]Various mini-games[/b] including mixology, bowling and more
[/list]
And secondly, we're still in the middle of development, and there are a lot of things we want your feedback on, so once you beat this demo, please make sure to fill in our [b][url=https://forms.gle/2TvLi98Rpgz2r34n8]Freaked Fleapit Post-Demo Questionnaire[/url][/b]! Your opinion might just give us the nudge into the right direction and hopefully make Fleapit even better!

Alright, I think we took enough of your precious time, so we won't keep you any longer! Go play the demo, share your feedback with us and we'll chat with you soon!

notes.title: OTK Games Expo marks the date for the Demo!
notes.content:
Hello, esteemed guests of Fleapit — soft sinners and certified freaks alike!

[b]Freaked Fleapit is going to be a part of… OTK Games Expo 2024! [/b][20th Century Fox fanfare.wav] 

[h2]Mark the date — June 4th at 12 pm PT, — because it’s also the day we’re gonna drop the demo!!![/h2]

You can watch the show on:
[list][*] [h3][url=https://www.twitch.tv/zackrawrr]Asmongold's Twitch Channel[/url][/h3]
[*] [h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/@OTKchannel/videos]OTK YouTube Channel[/url][/h3][/list]
However, [b]we have to set some expectations here[/b]. While we’re confident that you’re going to enjoy this short look at the game, we also have to emphasize that [b]it’s only The First Look. And here’s exactly what it’s going to contain:[/b]
[list][*] A peek at the beginning of Newbie’s journey! 
[*] Two levels to dance through — complete with boss fights at the end!
[*] Voice over — you saw our Japanese VO cast, but the demo will also include English VO as well! And it’s good! Word!!!
[*] Personal quests for the girls — after you finish the 1st level, you can take a unique quest from each of the girls. However, you have enough energy to get two of those during one playthrough, so choose wisely! You will be rewarded with a cute mini-date and a CG if you manage to complete the quest!
[/list]
And here are [b]all the languages that the First Look Demo is going to support[/b]:
[list][*] [b]Voiceover:[/b] English, Japanese, Š̶̩ė̴͜c̷̞͘r̷̘̈́e̸͕͗ṯ̷͠
[*] [b]Text:[/b] English, Frenchl, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese 
[/list]
[b]We plan to release a bigger demo later down the road[/b], but we just couldn’t tease you any longer without providing an opportunity to experience the game! Huh? We’re teasing you again by not telling you what’s gonna be in the bigger demo?! Aw man… Okay, we’re gonna tell you now!

[b]The improved Demo is going to include:[/b]
[list][*] Meta-progression — more fleshed out roguelite elements, traders, perks, skills, meta-currency and all that jazz
[*] 5 dates with branching dialogue set in different locations 
[*] The first 2 circles of Hell but this time bolder, bigger and more fun!
[*] Various mini-games including mixology, bowling and more
[/list]
Should be enough of a bone to feed! Anyway, this might’ve been a lot of info, so [b]don’t forget to mark June 4th 12 pm PT as the ‘Freaked Fleapit – First Look Demo’ Day!![/b]

[i]P.S. We’ve already started sending out the Steam codes to Patreon and Indiegogo backers eligible for Early Access. So you might wanna check the spam folder, if you don’t get it until Tomorrow evening![/i]


Don’t forget to follow us on Xitter (formerly known as just ‘The Bird Site’) and join the freakin Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other goofs and spoofs!

notes.title: Freaked Fleapit Dev HQ Direct — April ‘24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/a6ff1df2f8d3c9fb02042971ecca3d45992d0acd.png[/img]

Hey Guests of the Fleapit!

Guess who’s back with yet another grab-bag of a devlog! As always, we prepared a few topics from our [b]Development HQ [/b]that we can share and we hope you’ll enjoy what we have in store. So without further ado, let’s start with a deep dive into…

[h3]THE BOTTOMLESS PITS[/h3]

Every game worth its salt must have bottomless pits… or at least that’s the case for the Fleapit. A lot of players were wondering if they could fall into the pits found everywhere across the dungeon crawling section and were (apparently) disappointed when that wasn’t the case.

Well, congrats y'all, because we’re granting your wish to yeet yourselves into the void. Better watch your steps now cuz one wrong jump could become your doom (or take 1HP away from you, to be precise)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cbhUJyu.gif[/img]
[i]This is yet to be implemented in the actual build, so please enjoy this new enemy pattern with a placeholder sprite and a sneaky mini-map on the right[/i]

[h3]HERE COME THE NEW CHALLENGERS[/h3]

Speaking of more enemies: The Circles of Hell are chock full of all  manner of dangerous creatures, and we captured got a few of those we can show off today! 

Introducing the new demons straight from the deeper layers of Limbo: Bookworm, Coffee Maniac, and Archigoat! Feel free to speculate what their attack patterns are gonna be like, and what other demons might lurk deep within the Bureaucratic Inferno.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/87d55e0be717044aca1fd6d62b8f4482e9306a6b.png[/img]

[h3]NEW PERKS & SKILLS[/h3]

But that’s not all! We recently finished outlining some of the new perks and skills that you’ll encounter later in the game, and we can even tease what a couple of them will do:

[b]Card Shark:[/b] Get one extra perk to choose from a chest
[b]Barmaid’s Special: [/b]If Andy has all three types of HP, deal 150% more damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/ffc11e954076bdce23c7823d459e2774a167c5e3.png[/img]

We’ll be showcasing more of these in future devlogs, so stay stoked, and stay tuned for that!! Until then, feel free to throw your suggestions our way and maybe they might make it into the game . . .

[h3]FLEAPIT’S DEMO IS… IN ENGLISH??[/h3]

We’ve been talking about the Japanese VO for Fleapit so much, but we’ve been working hard on getting the full English VO for that demo in the background. Expect the Actual Announcement some time soon, but for now we can give you just a tiny teaser! 

[previewyoutube=D5wJMmCsDjw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]FLEAPIT’S QUICK TRIVIA BIT: THALES[/h3]

[i]A literal encyclopedia about the whole of Inferno found in the depths of Limbo. Despite his status as a literal bastion of knowledge, this scholar's main personality points fall somewhere between: extremely arrogant or extremely horny. 
…Maybe that talking tie wasn’t so bad after all?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e4805c002a4d22367d6586c6b809858087827095.png[/img]

That’s all the updates we have for today! Thank you for stopping by, and see you in the next Fleapit Direct (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up [url=http://patreon.com/FinchBird]on Patreon[/url] to learn more) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on Twitter (or X, or whatever it's called today) and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: A Freaked Fleapit Newsletter — February 2024!
notes.content:
Hey, guests of the Fleapit!

Another month passed by, another devlog has arrived! Looks like you enjoyed our grab bag format, so we’re running another one of these again. 

And now let's get straight to the show: 

[h2]WE MADE AUDIO CALIBRATION (and the rest of the options menu)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/50b7414f1a7d84c1fc8766cdc98e88b95b6425b9.png[/img]
[i]Design and settings are not final and subject to change![/i]

As a part of our preparations for the public demo launch (coming soon, promise!!), we finally made an actual Options menu and audio calibration! This is a more important update than it sounds because previously we were kind of operating on the basis of “let’s make the game first and all the inconsequential stuff later”.

Well, it turns out having an options menu and audio calibration for users is pretty darn important, so we’re happy finally getting that out of the way. There’s still a lot of work to be done, but we consider this another little milestone towards the full game.

[h2]DISCOVERING DIALOGUE ANIMATIONS[/h2]

[list] [img]https://i.imgur.com/pdPClQJ.gif[/img][/list]

You might’ve seen us posting a fourth-wall-breaking animation of Ruby’s dialogue on Twitter this month! Actually, we never really intended for them to be a part of the game and it’s something we just had fun with… 

…but seeing how many of you loved it on Twitter, we’re seriously considering putting them in the game for some extra special moments. Anyway, we’ve got one more for you right here so please enjoy!

[h2]DEVELOPMENT INSIGHTS: BUGS AND CREATIVITY[/h2]

Here’s a cute little thing we encountered during testing: Andy’s sprite turned into a sprite of another enemy by accident. Well, our first thought was this was annoying as Hell because we thought the build was pretty solid. But then we realized that this could become a mechanic, or an option for customization, or maybe even something else entirely!-

…orrr maybe not end up in the final game at all 🗿

Sometimes that’s just how things evolve throughout game development, new ideas are born not through sheer calculations and extensive planning, but rather through a random bug that popped up during playtesting sessions with the team!

[list][img]https://i.imgur.com/xGhSRKB.gif[/img][/list]

[h2]Quick Fleapit Trivia Bit: Lucyfall[/h2]

[i]Lucyfall is the most popular holiday in Inferno, dedicated to the fall and fall of Lucifer, as well as the sins of people: this is how demons honor those thanks to whom they exist and will continue to exist. 

This is also the perfect day for demons to try and claw their way to the top of the hierarchy with deception and trickery while others are busy celebrating.[/i]

[h2]COMING IN THE NEXT DEVLOG: BELLBOY'S PROFILE[/h2]

Join us next month as we reveal some of the mysteries of the Fleapit’s finest tomboy bartender! No spoilers though, promise! <3

As always, our next devlog will be available one week sooner for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: [url=http://patreon.com/FinchBird]http://patreon.com/FinchBird[/url] 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on Twitter (or whatever it’s called this week) and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

notes.title: A Freaked Fleapit Newsletter: Ep. 01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e2e6e75aa0a432d00602cec670afd9f5966135ea.gif[/img]

Hey deadbeats!

We here at [b]Freaked Fleapit Development HQ[/b] have been quite busy with a lot of different junk lately, so we wanted to share a bunch of updates with y’all! We’ve always wanted to do these newsletter-ish devlogs, so let us know if you like this format!

And now, let’s dive, jump, or backflip straight into news 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/f029f6b3520ef40e6601c5e967a6a2fd7d9f01c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Freaked Fleapit is coming to Bitsummit Let’s Gooo[/h3]

Words can’t even begin to describe how thrilled we are to be invited to the largest Japanese indie games festival! If you couldn’t tell by now, we’re heavily inspired by a number of super-talented Japanese game developers, and having the opportunity to show our game there with them fills us with great joy and excitement! <3

We’re going to have our own booth with a [b]brand new demo[/b] at Bitsummit on July 14 - 16. So if you happen to be in Japan during Bitsummit, come see us and say “Hi!”, will you?

And if not, our next segment is here for you 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/3fef25a26e978821a3347332139fbe2016d08f26.jpg[/img]

[h3]We’ve been working on a new demo![/h3]

If you’ve seen Freaked Fleapit at any live event previously, chances are you caught our old demo. We changed a looooot of stuff since then, and so we’ve been making a new and improved demo that will be more representative of Fleapit’s current state!

In this one we’re gonna give you the taste of both the revamped battle system and the narrative charm of Fleapit. That’s exactly the demo we’ll be showing at Bitsummit (aaaaaand other events that we can’t talk about just yet 🤐)
We don’t wanna spoil too much of the demo ahead of the event, but we can at least share a few new screenshots to get y’all excited. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/b5acf2004f41979ad8da8773a79f43bbbe45de4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/4fc928fed105331db0a64e9f1ce7e434d88ba625.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/4d6eaa2548efc7b73629a7c30a0e6a77353ba617.png[/img]

[h3]Working on the Lust Circle[/h3]

While a lot of our time has been (and still is) dedicated to the updated demo, we’re also making progress on the Lust Circle. We’re gonna keep this short, cuz we have a separate series for deep dives into all the Circles of Hell, but since you guys loved Sally so much, we’re gonna give you a sneak peek into her pixel art style 🥰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/83b03ad1a896ac6a01466a96cb3427f58e73cbb3.gif[/img]


[b]And in non-Fleapit news:[/b] Our friends at 2Awesome Studio announced their latest game on PC Gaming Show, which means we can show off the key art that our Lead Artist Mr. Psina made for their game!

Go check out [b]Altered Alma[/b], it’s a metroidvania with datesim elements, and as you can probably guess, we’re all for having dating sims in [b]Every Single Game Ever[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/1cde144aa5b8364e7e03b19ce0e9494b07109faf.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190700/Altered_Alma/

And that's a wrap for now! We hope you enjoyed this rapid-fire news devlog…thing, and hope to continue this format in the future. Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter and join the Discord server to stay up to date on all the news and other degen antics!

Thanks for sticking around, everyone!
